mapper.select: select * from ( select 'RESULT' as kind, r.result_id as id, l.lot_no, w.wo_no, p.op_seq, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, trim_scale(r.good_qty)::text as good_qty, trim_scale(r.scrap_qty)::text as scrap_qty, trim_scale(r.rework_qty)::text as rework_qty, trim_scale(r.repair_qty)::text as repair_qty, r.unit_cd, k.worker_cd, k.worker_nm, t.terminal_cd, e.equip_cd, r.work_day::text as work_day, r.shift_cd, r.entry_method, r.reversal_of_id, exists (select 1 from prd_result x where x.reversal_of_id = r.result_id) as reversed, r.reason, r.occurred_at, r.recorded_by from prd_result r join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = r.wo_id join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_proc_id = r.wo_proc_id left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = r.lot_id left join mst_worker k on k.worker_id = r.performed_by left join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = r.terminal_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = r.equip_id where r.lot_id in #{i} union all select d.kind, d.rework_id, l.lot_no, w.wo_no, p.op_seq, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, trim_scale(d.good_qty)::text, trim_scale(d.scrap_qty)::text, null, null, d.unit_cd, k.worker_cd, k.worker_nm, null, null, null, null, d.entry_method, null, false, d.reason, d.occurred_at, d.recorded_by from prd_rework d join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = d.wo_id join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_proc_id = d.wo_proc_id left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = d.lot_id left join mst_worker k on k.worker_id = d.performed_by where d.lot_id in #{i} ) x order by x.occurred_at, x.id limit #{limit}
select distinct wo_id from lot_master where wo_id is not null and lot_id in #{i}

select a.actual_id, w.wo_no, p.op_seq, p.proc_cd, a.param_cd, m.param_nm, trim_scale(a.value)::text as value, trim_scale(m.lsl)::text as lsl, trim_scale(m.usl)::text as usl, m.unit_nm, a.judge, a.source, a.entry_method, a.reversal_of_id, exists (select 1 from prd_param_actual x where x.reversal_of_id = a.actual_id) as reversed, e.equip_cd, a.occurred_at from prd_param_actual a join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_proc_id = a.wo_proc_id join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = p.wo_id join prd_wo_param m on m.wo_param_id = a.wo_param_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = a.equip_id where a.wo_proc_id in #{i} order by p.op_seq, a.occurred_at, a.actual_id limit #{limit}

select w.wo_no, p.op_seq, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, trim_scale(c.input_qty)::text as input_qty, trim_scale(c.good_qty)::text as good_qty, trim_scale(c.scrap_qty)::text as scrap_qty, trim_scale(c.rework_qty)::text as rework_qty, trim_scale(c.repair_qty)::text as repair_qty, trim_scale(c.eff_good_qty)::text as eff_good_qty, trim_scale(c.diff_qty)::text as diff_qty, c.tol_pct, c.first_op_yn, c.occurred_at, c.recorded_by from prd_wo_proc_close c join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = c.wo_id join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_proc_id = c.wo_proc_id where c.wo_id in #{i} order by w.wo_no, p.op_seq limit #{limit}

select w.wo_no, e.equip_cd, s.state_cat, r.reason_cd, r.reason_nm, s.start_at, s.end_at from cms_equip_state_log s join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = s.wo_id join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = s.equip_id left join cms_state_reason r on r.reason_id = s.reason_id where s.wo_id in #{i} order by s.start_at, s.state_log_id limit #{limit}

select r.receipt_id, h.node_cd, trim_scale(r.qty)::text as qty, r.unit_cd, r.entry_method, r.reversal_of_id, r.reason, r.occurred_at, r.recorded_by from prd_receipt r join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = r.node_id where r.lot_id = #{lotId} order by r.occurred_at, r.receipt_id limit #{limit}
